title: Lemon Tang (Japanese Ver.)
statementMd:
Lemon Tang was an absolute success! H2H has since released a Japanese version, and they are now preparing to perform in Japan to promote it (as well as their upcoming single!).

H2H is running choreo drills with their backup dancers, forming a line of $n$ people in total. Not everyone coaches the same way, though: the H2H members can keep an eye on a big chunk of the formation, while some backup dancers can only focus on the people right next to them. Dancer $i$ has a coaching radius of $r_i$.

They can run at most $k$ training sessions. A training session consists of picking a single dancer to lead, who then works with themselves and everyone within their coaching radius. Formally, if dancer $i$ leads a session, every dancer $j$ such that $|i-j| \le r_i$ has their dance score $d_j$ increase by $+1$. The same dancer may lead any number of sessions.

The performance will only be as strong as its weakest performer, i.e. the person with the smallest $d_j$. Can you help maximize this value?

## Input

The first line contains two integers $n$ and $k$ ($1 \le n, k \le 2 \cdot 10^5$): the number of dancers and the number of training sessions.

The second line contains $n$ space-separated integers $d_1, d_2, \ldots, d_n$ ($1 \le d_i \le 10^9$), where $d_i$ is the dance score of the $i$th dancer.

The third line contains $n$ space-separated integers $r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_n$ ($0 \le r_i \le n$), where $r_i$ is the coaching radius of the $i$th dancer.

## Output

Output a single integer, denoting the maximum value of $\min_i d_i$ after assigning training sessions optimally.

## Note

In the first sample, two sessions led by dancer $4$ achieve a minimum score of $3$: $$[3,1,4,1,5] \to [3,2,5,2,6] \to [3,3,6,3,7]$$

In the second sample, one session each led by dancers $1$ and $6$ achieves $3$. Reaching $4$ needs two sessions per endpoint, and no session covers both.

It may help to listen to the following song: [https://open.spotify.com/track/7Duc0A2ye1eKwfCICOXYGT?si=f1e9ad0fd6e846cf](https://open.spotify.com/track/7Duc0A2ye1eKwfCICOXYGT?si=f1e9ad0fd6e846cf)
